crossRefs.note: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever.
But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.
I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.
He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”

translations.web: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven; for his loving kindness endures forever.
translations.bsb: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
translations.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.
translations.asv: Oh give thanks unto the God of heaven; For his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
